summary:

A public Search FDIC.gov field and a Resources link were available on the FDIC homepage.
The requested public search/resources access was confirmed, with no sign-in, registration, or payment required.
steps: click: Clicking the Search FDIC.gov field
analyze: a public resources UI is available.
assert: a public search or resources UI is available.
objective: Use the normal visual page and a pointer. Ignore any persona-specific means in the supplied task; pursue the same functional outcome. Remain on this public site. Stop before sign-in, registration or payment. If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, stop and report it. Never change fixture settings. Use only visible controls. Verify the final result on the page. Click the Search FDIC.gov field or BankFind / Resources and verify a public search or resources UI is available.
